summary: Barclays PLC furnished a Form 6-K on October 9, 2026, disclosing the appointment of Goldman Sachs International as Joint Corporate Broker with immediate effect, working alongside existing broker J.P. Morgan Securities plc. No transaction, stake, price, premium, or recommendation is involved; the disclosure is a routine corporate-governance and broker-appointment notice furnished under General Instruction B. No board recommendation or advisor opinion beyond the broker appointment is stated. No structural, collateral, ownership, or regulatory-clock implications arise, and there is no risk-arb angle; the filing carries no special-situation relevance.
